source_quotes.n_subjects: Handling, ultrasound gel, and treatment otherwise were the same as that used for the groups exposed to FUS (KA + FUS group, n = 6).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: At week 14, animals participated in the 2nd FUS stimulation session, followed with behavioral testing during weeks 15–20 (denoted as B3).
source_quotes.blinding: Hippocampus and striatum volumes were defined by marking the voxels from each image slide and then summed through the entire slides by a blinded rater (via the Area Measure function of Image J).
source_quotes.sham_type: another KA-only animal group $( n = 8 )$ received isoflurane inhalation and sham FUS exposures (i.e., 0 MI and $\mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { S P T A } } \mathrm { ~ 0 ~ W / c m } ^ { 2 } )$
source_quotes.auditory_control: Although no control experiments were performed for this potential confounder, we did analyze the contralateral brain of the KA-only and KA + FUS animal as a partial control (Supplementary S5).
source_quotes.anaesthesia: During FUS exposure, isoflurane (2%) was used to mildly anesthetize and stabilize the animals during sonication.
source_quotes.safety_notes: The addition of two courses of FUS pulsations produced neither gliosis nor a chronic inflammatory efect on the sonicated site when compared to the non-KA group, indicating that $\mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { S P T A } } 0 . 5 \mathrm { W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ FUS did not injure brain tissue with these parameters (Supplementary S4).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A focused ultrasound transducer (Sonic Concept, U.S; fundamental frequency = 0.5 MHz, radius curvature = 64.3 mm) transmitted energy to the skull and tissues by a custom-made coupler containing water.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Based on our prior experience [16], the pulsed FUS transcranial exposure level was set to a peak negative pressure of 0.177 MPa (considering 23% transcranially attenuated acoustic pressure with an ex vivo rat skull placed between the transducer and hydrophone), which was equivalent to a level of 0.25-MI and spatial-peak pulse-average intensity $\mathrm { ( I _ { S P P A } ) } ~ 1 . 6 7 ~ \mathrm { W / c m } ^ { 2 }$
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.isppa_w_cm2: Based on our prior experience [16], the pulsed FUS transcranial exposure level was set to a peak negative pressure of 0.177 MPa (considering 23% transcranially attenuated acoustic pressure with an ex vivo rat skull placed between the transducer and hydrophone), which was equivalent to a level of 0.25-MI and spatial-peak pulse-average intensity $\mathrm { ( I _ { S P P A } ) } ~ 1 . 6 7 ~ \mathrm { W / c m } ^ { 2 }$
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: These settings were equivalent to $0 . 5 ~ \mathrm { W / c m ^ { 2 } }$ of $\mathrm { I _ { S P T A } }$ , which is under the limitation of FDA guidelines on ultrasound imagers $( \mathrm { i . e . , 0 . 7 2 W / c m ^ { 2 } I _ { S P T A } } )$ and our settings did not produce thermal efect in our previous study [16].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The PRF of exposure was set to 100 Hz with the attempt to reduce audible efect and sensible diferences [21, 22], and duty cycle was set to 30% based on our previous optimal setting [16].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: The PRF of exposure was set to 100 Hz with the attempt to reduce audible efect and sensible diferences [21, 22], and duty cycle was set to 30% based on our previous optimal setting [16].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Exposure duration was for three consecutive 10-min “on” periods segmented by 5-min intermittent “of” periods.

flags.reason: MRI sub-cohort for the KA+FUS group is reported separately (4/4/4 scans at three timepoints) and may be a subset of, or overlap partially with, the n=6 behaviourally-tested KA+FUS animals; the paper does not fully reconcile the two cohorts.
Individual pulse duration is not stated in the text; only PRF (100 Hz) and duty cycle (30%) are given, and computing pulse duration from these would be arithmetic rather than a stated value.

readout_other: T2-weighted MRI volumetry of hippocampus/striatum; open-field, sociability, cylinder, and Morris water maze behavioural tests; IBA-1 and TNF-alpha immunohistochemistry
direction_notes: Study assessed neuroprotective/structural (hippocampal and striatal volume preservation), anti-inflammatory (reduced IBA-1), and behavioural outcomes of pulsed FUS rather than direct neurophysiological excitability, so a simple excitatory/inhibitory direction was not assessed.
safety_notes: TNF-alpha staining showed no gliosis or chronic inflammatory effect at the sonicated site after two FUS treatments compared with non-KA controls, indicating no tissue injury with these parameters.

exposures.label: Pulsed FUS to right hippocampus (KA epilepsy model)

timing.protocol_description: Each FUS session consisted of three consecutive 10-min 'on' periods segmented by 5-min intermittent 'off' periods, delivered at week 9 and again at week 14 after kainic acid injection to the right amygdala (two courses of FUS in total).
